rationale: AJ is building dexterous robotic systems with deep hardware-software co-design expertise, while Fujia brings specialized hardware engineering experience from energy infrastructure projects. intro_message: AJ Chahal, meet Fujia Zhang — both hardware-first builders who could swap lessons on integrating complex mechanical systems with scalable infrastructure.
